notes.title: Paris Transylvania Update V.0.050
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here comes a small update that brings one new peg board to conquer, along with several usability improvements and minor fixes. 

V.0.050 Update
New Peg Board! One more strategic layout to master.

Improvements & Fixes

 Card Listing UI: Smaller cards in rows of five in card listing, for better overview.
 Inventory Usability: The “Use” button now only appears when an item can actually be used.
 World Map UX: Mouse wheel scrolling is now disabled when popups are open, to avoid accidental map movement.
 Editor: Game keyboard shortcuts disabeled in editor mode.
 Localizations: Human translations for Chinese traditional, Chinese Simplified, Japanese and Korean.

We've just recently split the demo into its own app, so you can now leave a review. Thanks for playing and keep sending us feedback, it really helps shape the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470480/Paris_Transylvania_Demo/

notes.title: The Big Art and Content Update is Here! Play the Demo!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
I have been terrible at posting proper release logs and have been silently launching updates in the wolf hour instead. But here is a big update on what has been implemented. (TL;DR at the top, full details below)

I finally had time to polish the visuals and really unify the game’s look. The new style is darker, a little rougher, and much closer to the vibe we originally imagined. Several streamers and testers pointed out the background art as a highlight, so I decided to fully commit to that style.

Last but not least, big thanks to the roguelike deckbuilding community for all the feedback and ideas. Stuff like the Plushie, Fly Agaric, and Red Pepper exist because of you, keep the ideas and feedback coming and help shape the game before launch, it's closing in fast.

TL;DR

 Visual Overhaul: The game now has a darker, rougher, and more cohesive art style with refreshed characters, environments, and UI to match the gothic-cartoon vibe.
 5 New Locations and lore: Explore The Dumping Grounds, Crimson Ruin, Red Lake, Moons Hollow, and Hanging Rock.
 New Relics and Cards: Tons of new relics and cards to experiment with, including fun effects like summoning a cat, detonating grenades, and raising max HP.
 Status Effects Expanded: New mechanics like Strong, Angry, Poisoned, Vulnerable, and more to spice up combat.
 Board Editor: Create and play your own custom boards.
 Quality of Life Improvements: Better tooltips, mouseover effects, and keybinding options.
 Fixes and Stability: Smoother performance, better UI interactions, and bug fixes.
 

Version Update: 0.039 to 0.047
Big Art Update 
 The visuals are now darker, rougher, and more cohesive.
New LocationsThe Dumping Grounds
 Crimson Ruin
 Red Lake
 Moons Hollow
 Hanging Rock
Lore Learn more about each location and the vampire clans that reign there by clicking the lore icon next to the location header.
New Relics
 Always Gary: Adds Gary to every battle. The more the merrier.
 Extra Wallet: Increases wallet by 1000. A portable treasure chest.
 Plushie: Transfers 10 percent shield to the next round. Early days comfort.
 Brass Knuckles: When dealing a new hand of cards, deals 100 damage to all enemies. A hand for a hand.
 Clover: On board refresh, gain 30 shield. Lucky you.
 Vampire Fang: When a monster is killed, gain 25 HP. Soul sip.
 Cherry: Raises max HP by 100. The cherry on top.
 Green Egg: Monsters spawn with 1 poison. A slightly cursed breakfast.
 Shop Discount: Adds 10 percent to your shop discount. Shop till you drop.
 Fortune Cookie: Transfers remaining mana to the next round. A bright future.
 Pickaxe: On wall hit, hit one peg and restore one peg. Mine those walls.
New Cards

 Gemstone: On peg hit, damage increases by 1. Shimmers mystically.
 Grenade: Explodes. On peg hit, deals 10 damage. Fire in the hole.
 Slice of Bacon: Lowers max HP by 100. On attack, deals 25 damage to all enemies. Worth it.
 Spyglass: Adds one bounce to the trajectory. Best guess.
 Blue Rose: When a monster is killed, gain 1 max HP. Healthy slow progress.
 Wooden Stick: On peg hit, deals 10 damage. Stick shaped.
 Space Rock: On peg hit, deals 20 damage. Random mana cost. Definitely not from here.
 Severed Hand: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and deals a new hand of cards. Dearly missed.
 Mega Eye: On peg hit, deals 10 damage. Huge.
 Piggy Bank: On peg hit, deals 10 damage. When a monster is killed, gain 30 gold coins. Oink oink.
 Toaster: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and electrocutes nearby pegs.
 Builder’s Hat: On peg hit, deals damage based on card count. Keep building.
 Double Axe: On peg hit, deals 10 damage to two enemies. Cutting edge technology.
 Yarn Ball: A cat appears. On peg hit, there is a chance the cat deals 25 instant damage to a random enemy.
 Anchor: On peg hit, deals 20 damage and applies 5 Strong.
 Fly Agaric: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and inflicts 5 Poisoned.
 Red Pepper: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and applies 5 Angry.
 The Grail: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and inflicts 5 Vulnerable. Finders keepers.
 Voodoo Doll: On peg hit, deals 10 damage and inflicts 5 Weak.
Status Effects

 Strong: Takes 25 percent less damage for the next NN attacks.
 Angry: Deals 25 percent more damage for the next NN attacks.
 Poisoned: Loses 50 HP each round for the next NN rounds.
 Vulnerable: Takes 25 percent more damage for the next NN attacks.
 Weak: Deals 25 percent less damage for the next NN turns.
 Protected: Gains 25 percent more shield for the next NN attacks.
 Defenseless: Gains 25 percent less shield for the next NN attacks.
Status Effect Items

 Strong: Takes 10 percent less damage for the next NN attacks.
 Angry: Deals 10 percent more damage for the next NN attacks.
 Poisoned: Loses 10 HP each round for the next NN rounds.
 Vulnerable: Takes 10 percent more damage for the next NN attacks.
 Weak: Deals 10 percent less damage for the next NN attacks.
 Protected: Gains 10 percent more shield for the next NN attacks.
 Defenseless: Gains 10 percent less shield for the next NN attacks.
Tooltips and Quality of Life

 Tooltip added on Exhaust
 Tooltip added on relic display
 More tooltips added
 Relic mouseover enabled
 Mouseover on room names
 Neculai mouseover enabled
Fixes
 Mouseover effects on UI
 Enemies closing in are now capped and stop before passing the player
 Window resizing now works correctly
 HP is always displayed during special events
 Board Editor
 Built-in board editor added. Create your own boards and play custom runs.
 Check the mod resources folder in the install directory for example files.
 Improved SVG examples included.
 Improved grid system.
 Editor now supports windowed mode.
 Set your own difficulty level when starting a new run. Is hard mode even possible? Let me know.
Key Bindings and Inputs

 Mouse scroll changes card
 Mouse scroll also scrolls map
 1 2 3 4 5 to select cards
 Q to view relics
 W to view deck
 E to view inventory
 D to swap card forward
 A to swap card backward
 R to end turn
 S to skip button
 Z and C for action buttons like pinball flippers
 X and V to swap target
 L to open lore
 You can personalize keys in the settings.

notes.title: Paris Transylvania Update 0.039
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
It's finally time for a BIG update of the Paris Transylvania demo! Play it here on Steam, and join our community on Discord to share feedback, ideas, and help us test new features—lots of content is in the making.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459560/Paris_Transylvania/

New in 0.039:

New Content:
2 New Boards
5 New Events
3 New Relics:
• Blue Rose: On monster kill, gain 1 max HP. Healthy slow progress.
• Slice of Bacon: Lower max HP by 100. On attack, deal 50 damage to all enemies. Worth it!
• Spyglass: Add 1 bounce to the trajectory. Best guess...
3 New Cards:
• Grenade: Explodes! On peg hit, deals 10 damage. Fire in the hole!
• Gemstone: On peg hit, damage increased by 1. Shimmers mystically.
• Popcorn: On peg hit, deals 3 damage. 20% chance to spawn another Popcorn.
3 New Enemies:
• Dweller
• Big Fish
• Little Fish
1 New Item: Phoenix Feather: Restore the peg board.

New Features:
• Onboarding popup instructions
• Full screen/windowed mode
• Change active fullscreen monitor by windowing, dragging to the new monitor, then fullscreen on the new monitor
• Controller support

Improvements:
• Randomize attack numbers position so several numbers can be displayed at once
• Increase the chance of different random events appearing
• Added a shopkeeper
• All languages supported

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed a game-breaking bug where the game froze when a projectile clipped outside the level.
• Fixed a bug where Gary fell through the ground.
• Reduced projectile collision geometry by 30% for better aim.

Join us on Discord and be a part of our development journey. We appreciate your feedback and support!

notes.title: Paris Transylvania Update v0.036
notes.notes:
Hey all!

A major updated demo is FINALLY here for all of you to sink your teeth into :) We are so excited to bring you this update full of new content and bug fixes... including new playable characters! We have lots of goodies in this v0.036 release!

Watch us play it live on March 27th at 12/noon PT, and you can play it too, for free here on Steam! 

Join our Discord and please give us feedback on anything - bugs, new content ideas, difficulty balance, areas of improvement; your help is appreciated! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44223468/13abf6a055a520e027e59449b49312bf92fec994.png

What’s new in the Demo:

 Three playable characters - now you can play as one of the accidental heroes: Marie Antoinette, who escaped the guillotine in Paris; Jiro, the mysterious ninja with a shadowy past; or Froggy, who fled from a plate in a fancy restaurant. Each has their own unique set of cards. (With more planned)
 25 fully implemented cards (a lot more to come)
 15 relics (a lot more to come)
 18 different peg boards (a lot more to come)
 Mysterious events that can help or harm you. 
 Gameplay Length: 30 minutes of unique content, but endlessly replayable for building massive builds.

The final game will offer endless exploration and high replayability, with a single runtime of approx. 60 minutes. Explore three expansive world maps, packed with more than 100+ cards and relics, mysterious events, challenging encounters, thrilling boss fights, and numerous secrets, unlocks and items to be found. 

Streamers and Content Creators:
If you stream or make videos and are interested in covering Paris Transylvania, we would love that! We have included a press kit in the demo, with all assets added.

Happy vampire slaying! ❤️

Join the Paris Transylvania community:

notes.title: GAME DEVELOPERS SHOCK FANS with Mind-Blowing Update!
notes.notes:
Finally, the 2.5D background art is in place! Little by little everything comes together. We're working hard on ambiance and style. Adding more locations and juicing up the whole experience. Apparently the Hand Fan relic and the Crucifix relic never ever worked, I multiplied the wrong value... So give them a try now! Or did they work at some point, and I somehow messed them up? Tell us in our Discord!

Change log:

All values multiplied by 10 to avoid decimals.
Hit display values visible until the next card is selected.

New background art, with parallax:

 Resting place
 Random events
 Level animations

New boss level location and art:

 Moving grass
 Moving branches
 Camera shake
 Tweaked camera animations
 More bloom

HUD improvements:

 Removed lone damage counter below the player.
 Removed small coin counter below coins.
 Turn counter added to keep track of turn-based relics.
 Coin symbol now in the HUD instead of text in the level. Will be implemented in all scenes.

Broken relics and cards fixed:

 Hand Fan relic
 Ancient Rune relic
 Crucifix relic
 Silver dollar card

Visual enhancements:

 Textured popups and HUD.
 Numerous small graphics updates.
